item.message: Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled. Code mode will fail closed; enable `features.code_mode_host` and install `codex-code-mode-host`.

item.text: Exit code zero only indicates the process ended without reporting an operating-system-level error; it does not prove the AI CLI completed its intended work or emitted a usable result. A successful terminal event provides an explicit application-level confirmation that the requested task reached its expected completion state.
